rules: No generic sans fonts (Inter, Roboto). Use Chivo for all UI copy.
Use JetBrains Mono for all numbers, metrics, tags, statuses, tooltips, timestamps, and small labels.
Headings should be uppercase and tightly tracked (tracking-tighter) for the technical OS feel.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: High-density Control Room. Information heavy, utilizing all screen real estate. The Grid Borders look.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid #27272A. Grid borders visible everywhere. Expose the skeleton.

panels.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-zinc-800 flex flex-col h-screen bg-[#09090B]
panels.unified_inbox: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-[280px_1fr_300px] h-screen h-full border-collapse

spacing_and_layout.padding: Tight inside widgets (p-3 or p-4), generous between major sections (gap-4).

components.buttons: rounded-none px-4 py-2 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest border border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors. Primary button is bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200.
components.cards: rounded-none border border-zinc-800 bg-[#09090B] p-0 overflow-hidden. Use inner padding on sub-elements. Hard lines.
components.inputs: rounded-none border border-zinc-800 bg-[#18181B] px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white transition-all font-mono
components.badges: rounded-none border border-zinc-700 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-300
components.tables: Dense rows. font-mono text-xs for data cells. 1px border-b border-zinc-800. No zebra striping, just hover states (hover:bg-zinc-900/50).
components.chat_bubbles: rounded-none border border-zinc-800 p-3 text-sm. AI/System messages get a left border highlight of #FF5500.

motion.hover_states: Crisp and immediate. bg-zinc-900 -> bg-zinc-800. Border color changes.

media_and_images.rules: Use avatars for unified inbox contacts. Use abstract logos for CRM integration placeholders. Do not use generic placeholders.

icons: phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard usage. Weight: regular or bold.

testing.rules: All interactive elements, buttons, nav links, forms, and chat threads MUST have descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: Chivo and JetBrains Mono.
Set up Tailwind dark mode with the specified color palette (Zinc scale + Industrial Orange #FF5500).
Build a multi-pane layout for the Unified Inbox module (Sidebar -> Inbox List -> Chat View -> Contact Info Sidebar).
Override all Shadcn component border radii to `rounded-none`. The aesthetic is strict, brutalist, and technical.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the main app scaffolding to ensure the 'Control Room' dense grid border look. Use 1px borders between all major panes.
No marketing pages. Root path `/` should render a dark, technical Login screen, routing immediately to the App Dashboard layout.
Ensure high contrast on active states (e.g., currently selected conversation in the inbox list should have a stark white left border and bg-zinc-900).
